briefdescription.para: Analyze current system metrics and generate remediation hints.

detaileddescription.para: Runs all registered patterns against the supplied metrics and generates hints for any patterns that match. Duplicate hints (same problem detected within deduplication window) are filtered; only new unique problems are emitted to listeners.

metrics
Map of metric name -> current value. Can be empty (returns empty hints vector).
Vector of newly-generated hints (empty if no problems detected or if hint generation is disabled via setHintGenerationEnabled(false)).
@thread_safety Thread-safe. Multiple threads can call this concurrently. Pattern matching and deduplication use reader locks.

simplesect.para:
For each matching pattern:
Pattern::match() is called (must complete in < 10ms)
Hint is checked against deduplication window
If unique, hint is added to active set and listeners notified
If duplicate, deduplication counter incremented (no listener notification)
If any listener notification fails (listener deallocated or listener throws), error is logged but other listeners continue to be notified.
Malformed input (null metric names, invalid categories) is rejected with ORE_INVALID_METRIC_DATA error code and skipped (no hint generated).

briefdescription.para: Set the deduplication time window for hints.

detaileddescription.para: Hints with the same category and title generated within this time window are considered duplicates and only the first is emitted to listeners.

window
Time window duration. Recommended: 5 minutes (default). Must be > 0. Edge cases:
Very short windows (< 1s): high duplicate traffic
Very long windows (> 1h): alerts suppressed for too long
@thread_safety Thread-safe. Window change applies to all future hints. In-flight deduplication checks may use old or new window (last-writer-wins semantics).

simplesect.para: Window rounding is done on hint generation timestamp: timestamp_rounded = floor(current_time / window_size) * window_size This ensures clock skew tolerance of ±(window_size/2) ≈ ±2.5 minutes for default 5-minute window.

briefdescription.para: Operator remediation engine for automated incident diagnostics.

detaileddescription.para:
The OperatorRemediationEngine provides utilities for:
Detecting common observability problems from metric patterns
Generating actionable remediation hints for operators
Tracking and deduplicating hints over time
Providing documentation links and runbook references
Supporting custom pattern matching for domain-specific problems

sect2.title: Thread-Safety Guarantees

para.bold: All public methods are thread-safe for concurrent access:

listitem.para: Listener addition/removal: safe concurrent calls with proper weak_ptr handling
Metric analysis: multiple threads can analyze simultaneously
Hint queries: safe snapshot returns for queries
Statistics: atomic counter updates and snapshot reads

sect2.para:
Thread-safety implementation uses:
Reader-writer locks for hint store and pattern registry
Generation counters for stale weak_ptr detection
Atomic operations for flags and counters
Lock-free reads in performance-critical paths

listitem.para: Cardinality explosion detection and label-dropping suggestions
Exporter connectivity monitoring with fallback recommendations
Latency anomaly detection with batch-size/flush-interval tuning hints
Memory pressure detection with retention policy adjustment suggestions
Queue overflow handling with backpressure tuning recommendations
Span loss monitoring with sampling rate adjustment hints

sect2.title: Performance Characteristics
sect2.para:
Benchmark gates (Phase 5 validation):
Listener notification throughput: ≥100k hints/sec
Hint generation latency P95: ≤50µs
Pattern matching throughput: ≥500k matches/sec
Deduplication lookup latency P99: ≤10µs
Active hint set query latency: ≤5ms
Hint resolution P95: ≤100µs
All operations are deterministic with seed kObservabilityPhase5Seed = 42.

sect2.title: Integration Pattern
sect2.para:
Error codes (from observability_api_contract.h extension):
ORE_PATTERN_MATCH_ERROR = 26: Pattern matching failed
ORE_INVALID_METRIC_DATA = 27: Malformed metric input (null name, invalid category)
ORE_LISTENER_NOTIFICATION_FAILED = 28: Listener notification failed
ORE_DUPLICATE_PATTERN = 29: Pattern name already registered
ORE_INTERNAL_ERROR = 30: Unexpected internal error

Most methods return boolean or vector; failures are reported via:
Return value (false for addListener if full or null)
Statistics API (listener eviction count, failed notifications)
Listener callback errors (implementation-dependent)
Memory Bounds and Listener Eviction (Phase 3 Hardening)

Listener count is bounded (default: 10k max listeners):
New listeners rejected if count exceeds limit
Oldest listeners evicted in FIFO order when cap hit
Eviction event tracked in statistics
Dead listeners (deallocated) cleaned up opportunistically
Deduplication and Clock Skew Tolerance (Phase 3 Hardening)

Hints are deduplicated within configurable time window (default: 5 minutes):
Duplicate detection is deterministic even with +/- 1 minute clock skew
Hint ID includes problem category + timestamp (rounded to window size)
UUID component prevents accidental collisions
Deduplication counter incremented for each duplicate attempt

simplesect.para: Weak pointer listener tracking (Phase 3 hardening) means listeners can be safely deallocated without explicitly removing them from the engine. Stale listeners will be silently skipped during notification.
